name: content_hash
description: SHA-256 hex of the raw PDF bytes. Primary key; announcements are immutable, amendments are new rows.

name: announcement_id
description: ASX idsId, e.g. 03084954 - the identifier that resolves to the PDF. With ticker+date, lets the public golden dataset cite filings without republishing them.

name: document_type
description: ASX announcementType, e.g. PERIODIC REPORTS. Only the JSON endpoint exposes this; rows ingested from the HTML listing have NULL.

name: document_url
description: Resolved announcements.asx.com.au PDF URL the bytes were fetched from.

name: announced_at
description: When the market learned the information (ASX release timestamp, UTC). Point-in-time joins key on this.

name: ingested_at
description: When WE stored it (UTC). Kept separate from announced_at for leakage-audit hygiene.
